name: Porpoise
summary: Dedicated GameCube and Wii emulator front end for Dolphin on PS5.
description: A native Dolphin front end for PS5 with a cover-flow library, box art, memory cards and original menu music. Uses the libretro Dolphin core and a PS5 Vulkan/RADV driver. RetroAchievements are surfaced through the ELF loader.
author: elripalda
warnings: Requires the HEN to leave the app sandbox at launch.
